candidates.speaker: Michael Huemer
candidates.proposition: Appearances are the basis of every plausibly justified belief, and rejecting a presumption that things are as they appear would eliminate justification altogether.
candidates.attributionBasis: This is a continuous first-person epistemological argument within Huemer's moderator-introduced closing statement and follows his definition of intuition.

candidates.speaker: Michael Huemer
candidates.proposition: Realism itself need not be the default; the relevant presumption favors appearances, from which the way morality appears to most people can support realism.
